The isotope pattern with ~14.2% at M+1 and ~1.14% at M+2 is consistent with a compound containing carbon atoms (natural abundance of 13C is ~1.1% per carbon atom).

Let me calculate possible molecular formulas for a mass of ~181.065:

Actually, let me recalculate more precisely:
C9H11NO3 exact mass = 9×12.000 + 11×1.00783 + 14.00307 + 3×15.99491 = 108.000 + 11.08613 + 14.00307 + 47.98473 = 181.07393

This matches well with the observed 181.06533!

The compound with molecular formula C9H11NO3 has a molecular weight of 181.074, and the [M+H]+ would be 182.074, which matches the observed m/z 182.073.
